finalText:
It builds clean now, no errors, exit code 0.

Two things in `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js` broke from the bump, and I fixed both:

1. The new bundler passes retry settings as `retryCount`, but the code was still reading the old name, `retries`. That made it crash. Fixed it to read `retryCount`.
2. The new config loader leaves a flag unset as `undefined` instead of `false`. The code only knew about `true` and `false`, so `undefined` made it throw. Now anything that isn't `true` just means backoff is off, same as before.

The rest of the warnings, deprecation notices and a couple of style nags, are just noise from the bump and don't block anything. Build finishes in 44.9 seconds with 8 warnings and 0 errors.
